scope: Actual API route, authz, job-store, public-data and artifact-validation source loaded into an isolated VM context.
Real SQLite engine applies every checked-in Drizzle SQL migration; D1 binding behavior and R2 object store are in-memory adapters.
External ChatGPT identity is replaced by explicit owner, non-owner, anonymous and administrator fixtures; runner authentication code is executed unchanged.
Approval hash binding, submission idempotency, same-origin checks, ownership and runner credentials.
Concurrent claims, exact lease retry, lease expiration without requeue, cancellation races, old sequence compare-and-swap, terminal-state protection.
Exact finalization replay, unresolved-cost blocking, private artifact access, artifact bytes and job ownership, manifest audit-seed binding.
Cross-job replay route uniqueness and a lease expiring between R2 upload and SQL registration.
Strict nested schemas, evidence/model classification, fixed-I and same-H consistency, paired seeds and means, lineage integrity, policy-failed matches without fake replays.
V3 audit task failures preserve score zero and their cause; complete audits cannot carry a failure cause.
Replay identities, continuous frames, round totals, player IDs, terrain positions and mine ownership counts; public string path/credential filtering.
limits: No paid model requests, real MoneCraft execution, Docker runs or external network requests were performed by this suite.
This is controlled source-level API integration testing, not a deployed Cloudflare D1/R2 test or an external identity-provider verification.
Race conditions are deterministic SQL interleavings injected immediately before updates/inserts; this is not a production load test.
Historical replay files are read-only validation fixtures; their validation does not rerun games or establish RSI gains.
String filters are defense in depth, not a proof that arbitrary model content is safe to publish; only the trusted allowlist publisher is authorized.
The current development execution container remains outside the safety scope of this review.
